caption:
A whale girl knocks on four doors and gets four very different welcomes 😭

The copycat twist halfway through had me crying.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 58 seconds, 16:9 landscape. 2D anime chibi illustration style: super-deformed cute characters about 2.5 heads tall, huge sparkling eyes, soft cel shading with glowing highlights and gentle bloom, pastel storybook backgrounds in bright sunny daylight (except the neon nightclub at the end). Camera feel: mostly locked-off storybook two-shots with gentle slow push-ins, like an animated comedy skit. Pacing: light comedy in four house chapters, bouncy character animation, a cross-dissolve between some scenes, ending with an iris-out circle to black. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTERS (keep identical in every shot):
- WHALE GIRL (the hero): chibi girl with very long wavy hair, deep navy blue at the roots fading to bright cyan-blue at the ends, one ahoge strand on top, big round sky-blue eyes, a white frilly maid headband, a small light-blue ribbon bow on the left side of her head, a pair of dark-navy whale-fin flaps sticking out sideways from her head like ears, and a large navy-blue whale tail with a pale-blue underside and a forked fluke curling behind her. Navy-blue long-sleeve maid dress with white frilly collar and cuffs, white ruffled apron with a small blue whale emblem on the front, white ruffled petticoat hem, white frilly socks, black Mary Jane shoes with small orange bows.
- ORANGE GIRL (mansion owner): chibi girl, very long wavy bright-orange hair with an ahoge, a large orange flower ornament with a black ribbon and white tassels on the left side of her head, amber-gold eyes, white puffy-sleeved blouse with a black bow at the collar, black corset bodice, layered skirt of black lace over orange with a white ruffled hem, cream lace-up ankle boots. Haughty and smug, often arms crossed. Holds an ornate golden key.
- SILVER GIRL (modern house owner): chibi girl, long fluffy silver-white hair with a white rose ornament, two curved white dragon horns, small lavender dragon wings at the sides of her head and on her back, pointed elf ears, violet eyes, flowing white off-shoulder dress with long wide sleeves, white socks and shoes. Gentle and kind.
- CAT GIRL (cabin owner): chibi girl, long wavy lavender-purple hair fading to pink at the tips with a small side bun and a star-shaped hair clip, fluffy purple cat ears, heterochromatic eyes (one pink-red, one golden-yellow), purple-and-white frilly dress with lace sleeves, a fluffy purple-to-pink cat tail, white frilly leg warmers, purple platform shoes. Bubbly and energetic.
- BLONDE GIRL (nightclub owner): chibi girl, long golden-blonde twin tails tied with black bat-wing-shaped bows, a small gold crown on top, sky-blue eyes, small black bat wings on her back, black long-sleeve gothic dress with gold trim and gold buttons and a red-lined ruffled skirt, black thigh-high stockings, black shoes. Confident, cheeky grin.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:03.9) — Crossroads opening. Wide establishing shot of a sunny fantasy village crossroads: a pale stone footpath forking left and right across green lawns dotted with white and blue flowers, a wooden fence post and old iron lamp posts in the foreground; in the distance, left to right: a grand white European mansion with grey slate turrets, a modern white minimalist cube house, a cozy wooden cabin among pine trees, and a purple-and-blue neon-lit nightclub building, with a blue sea horizon, blue sky and big fluffy white clouds. The WHALE GIRL stands centered on the path holding a rolled parchment scroll, gives a cheerful salute-wave, then closes her eyes in a huge happy smile. Locked-off with a very slight push-in.

SHOT 2 (00:03.9-00:11.3) — The locked mansion. Medium two-shot at the mansion entrance: pale stone steps, pink roses in both foreground corners, a black iron fence, cream walls and turrets behind, and on frame right a tall carved dark-wood double door with gold scrollwork. MUST SHOW: a big shiny golden padlock hanging on the door handles. The WHALE GIRL skips in from frame left with arms open, beaming. The ORANGE GIRL stands at the door with one hand on her hip, dangles and shakes the golden key at her with a smug closed-eye smile, then crosses her arms and says dismissively: "哼！我家不欢迎你来，哪来的哪回去！" The whale girl's smile slowly fades. Static camera.

SHOT 3 (00:11.3-00:15.9) — Rejected. Same place, framed slightly wider. The WHALE GIRL bursts into comical crying, mouth wide open. MUST SHOW: two fountain-like streams of blue anime tears spraying sideways from her eyes and small tear puddles splashing on the stone steps. The ORANGE GIRL keeps her arms crossed, eyes closed, chin up, ignoring her. The whale girl turns and runs off frame left, tail swinging.

SHOT 4 (00:16.0-00:21.9) — Building a shack. Hard cut to a sunny lawn beside the mansion (mansion in the background on the right, white picket fence, pink roses, a wooden fence in the foreground). The WHALE GIRL now wears a yellow construction hard hat and swings a hammer. MUST SHOW: wooden posts and planks flying up and slamming together in puffs of brown dust, rapidly assembling on frame left into a small crooked, shabby wooden shack about twice her height, with a slanted patched roof, a grey-framed window, a plain plank door and taped, patched boards, plus a small wooden sign nailed above the door. She wipes her forehead, then grins proudly with the hammer in hand.

SHOT 5 (00:22.0-00:28.3) — The copycat. Wide shot: the shack on the left, the white mansion behind on the right, the ORANGE GIRL standing on the right with arms crossed. The WHALE GIRL spins in a pirouette. MUST SHOW: a ring of golden glitter and ribbons of light spiraling around her whole body while her hair and dress shimmer and morph. She emerges as an exact copy of the orange girl (long orange hair, orange flower ornament, white blouse, black-and-orange layered skirt, cream boots, holding a golden key) but still with her sky-blue eyes and her blue whale tail. She poses smugly, hand on hip, eyes closed in a satisfied smile, while the real ORANGE GIRL first closes her eyes calmly, then her eyes pop open and she gasps, mouth wide, hands raised in shock.

SHOT 6 (00:28.4-00:34.9) — The key on the stand. Hard cut to a bright modern minimalist house: smooth white walls, big glass windows, a tall light-wood front door with a black digital keypad smart lock, a waist-high white stone pedestal beside it, green potted plants in the foreground. The WHALE GIRL (back in her own navy maid look) on the left, the SILVER GIRL on the right. The silver girl smiles warmly, sets a small key on top of the white pedestal and gestures toward it, saying gently: "我把钥匙放在这，你想进来可以自己开门哦~" The whale girl looks at the key, puzzled, then glances back at her. Static medium two-shot.

SHOT 7 (00:35.0-00:39.9) — The open cabin. Soft cross-dissolve to a sunny cozy wooden cabin: mossy roof, flower boxes under latticed windows, a warm glowing wall lantern, a big arched wooden door swung wide open; behind them a blue lake and mountains, pink and white flowers in the foreground. The WHALE GIRL bounds in from the left on one foot; the CAT GIRL stands at the open door waving with both hands and says happily: "大肥鱼，我家不关门，来一起玩呀！" The whale girl squeezes her eyes shut in delight. Medium two-shot, static.

SHOT 8 (00:40.0-00:43.9) — Dance together. Tighter medium two-shot at the same cabin, both girls side by side facing the camera doing a synchronized cute dance: hands on hips, hip sways, one-leg kicks, then a spin. MUST SHOW: colorful floating music-note sparkles and pink petals drifting around them.

SHOT 9 (00:44.0-00:50.9) — The nightclub. Hard cut to night at the entrance of a nightclub that has no door: glossy reflective dark floor, purple and pink neon light strips on dark pillars, a red velvet rope on brass stanchions, potted plants, a big mirror disco ball and blue and purple spotlight beams, silhouettes of dancers inside. The BLONDE GIRL stands confidently with hands on hips, then points and sweeps one arm toward the inside, grinning; the WHALE GIRL stands shyly, hands clasped at her chest, blushing. The blonde girl says: "房子哪需要门，都是哥们，快来我家，我家有的是好东西。" Static medium two-shot.

SHOT 10 (00:51.0-00:53.9) — Buddies. Quick cross-dissolve: the BLONDE GIRL throws her arm around the WHALE GIRL's shoulders, both laugh with eyes closed, and they turn toward the club.

SHOT 11 (00:54.0-00:57.8) — Into the club. Medium-wide view from behind: the two walk side by side, arm in arm, into the neon dance floor full of spotlights and dancing silhouettes, the blonde twin tails and the whale tail swaying. At 00:55.3 an iris-out: the picture shrinks into a circle centered on the two girls, the circle closes to a dot, and the screen is fully black from 00:57.0 to the end.

SOUND: light, playful instrumental background music throughout (plucky strings and glockenspiel), switching to an upbeat cute electronic dance beat during the dance in shot 8 and a thumping club bass beat with crowd murmur in shots 9-11. All dialogue in Mandarin Chinese with cute anime voices: the orange girl cool, haughty and dismissive; the silver girl soft and gentle; the cat girl bright and bubbly; the blonde girl brash and cheeky. Effects: footstep pitter-patter, the key jingling in shot 2, a comedic wail and splashing tears in shot 3, hammer bangs, wood clatter and dust puffs in shot 4, a magical shimmer whoosh in shot 5, a sparkly chime as the key is set down in shot 6, a soft whoosh on the iris-out.
prompt_short: Chibi anime skit, 16:9: a blue-haired maid girl with a whale tail visits 4 houses. An orange-haired girl locks her out, she cries, builds a shack and copies her look; a silver girl leaves a key; a cat girl dances with her; a blonde girl hugs her into a neon club.
